title: Mid-level Python Engineer | 2–3 Yrs Exp | Flask/FastAPI | REST APIs
meta_description: Join as a Mid-level Python Engineer with 2–3 years of experience in Flask/FastAPI, REST APIs, Git & GenAI tools. Take ownership & grow into leadership.
clean_text:
Mid-level Python Engineer
Experience : 2 - 3 Years
No of opening - 1
We are seeking a Mid-level Python Engineer who can deliver sub-modules independently, coordinate with clients if needed, and support junior developers. You will work under an experienced engineer for larger projects.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy Python applications and sub-modules.
Take ownership of features within bigger projects.
Support senior engineers by delivering high-quality code.
Guide junior engineers when needed.
Join client meetings for technical discussions.
Use GenAI tools for productivity.
Debug and maintain legacy code.
Follow Git and CI/CD best practices.
Requirements
2–3 years of Python development.
Strong understanding of core Python, OOPs, and design patterns.
Proficiency in Flask or FastAPI.
Experience with REST APIs and databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Familiarity with Git and Agile development.
Good communication and debugging skills.
Exposure to GenAI tools for development.
Bonus: Docker, AWS/Azure cloud basics.
Growth & Team Expectation:
Take ownership of sub-modules.
Work under senior engineers on larger projects.
Clear path to grow into a senior role.
Soft Skills:
Ownership mindset.
Strong communicator and team collaborator.
Ability to mentor and work independently.
HR Department
At Sculptsoft, we’re always on the lookout for talented professionals to join our team. Submit your resume and take the first step toward an exciting career with us.
